final: WITH g AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebrate * 1.0 / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), a AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.orderslink, g.avg_ratio, g.cnt, g.avg_ratio / NULLIF(a.overall, 0) AS rel FROM g JOIN a ON a.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (g.avg_ratio / NULLIF(a.overall, 0)) IS NULL, g.avg_ratio / NULLIF(a.overall, 0) DESC LIMIT 10
